transcript: Did you know that having dogs and cats in your home is one of the most powerful forms of protection that exists? Before evil enters your home, your animals already know it. They fight battles for you that you cannot see while you sleep peacefully. What sounds to you like barking at nothing is your dog defending you against what your eyes cannot reach. Your dog detects energetic danger before anyone else. It places itself between you and the door, growls at empty corners, goes on alert for no apparent reason. It is not anxious, it is protecting. Your cat absorbs darkness and envy and transforms it. It sits where the energy is densest, stares at what you cannot see, and when it curls up next to you, it is cleansing what you carry. They are not pets. They are guardians sent to protect your home and your soul. In our monastery, we always had both. The dog watches what tries to come in. The cat cleanses what already got in. If your dog barks at night for no reason, do not silence it. If your cat stares fixedly at a point, let it be. They are working for you, care for them, respect them, thank them every day. They do more than you can imagine. Write in the comments, my guardians. If you have a dog or a cat, but I want you to understand something. Your animals protect your space from what comes from outside. But what hurts you most many times does not come from outside. It comes from within. The stress you carry, the emotions you accumulate, the fear you will not release. No animal can cleanse that. You have to let it go yourself. Your guardians watch over your home. But your inner peace can only be built by you. And if you want to learn how to build that peace that your animals already know you need, I have spent more than 20 years learning in silence how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path. Back to calm. The link is in my profile.
